run_set_img_urls_dedup: run the script to deduplicate web documents by filtering banned URL and WARC filename pairs from S3
create_SetImgURLsDeduplication: create a SetImgURLsDeduplication instance with a path to a JSON ban list of URLs and WARC filenames
filter_dataset_with_SetImgURLsDeduplicat: filter a HuggingFace dataset by calling SetImgURLsDeduplication as a callable to remove documents matching banned URL WARC pairs
extract_image_urls_from_metadata: extract image source URLs from web document metadata and count their occurrences using Counter
sync_dataset_to_s3: sync the filtered web document dataset and image URL pickle file from local disk to S3 storage
